evidence.reason: The implementation compares GitHub login strings case-sensitively for `automationLogin`, `excludedLogins`, and `trustedAuthors`. GitHub logins are case-insensitive, so an exclusion or automation login written with different casing fails to match and fails open; an excluded user can then be trusted if `trustedAuthors` contains the actual casing. No supplied contract defines login matching as case-sensitive, so this is a minor implementation defect rather than merely a hardening proposal.
